name: Concrete pipe; 36" inch diameter; at plant
description: This unit process reflects production of 1 linear foot of 36" diameter concrete pipe.
category: 31-33: Manufacturing/3273: Cement and Concrete Product Manufacturing

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Data collected 2011. Background electricity data updated.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: Inventory exchange values were sourced directly from the cited EPA report on disinfection options in municipal drinking water treatment. Background data sources have, in some cases, been updated to reflect newer and/or public data sources. Elementary flows were mapped to the federal elementary flow list.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Infrastructure end-of-life treatment/disposal is excluded. Some relevant flows not captured.The mass balance for this process was not calculated.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Pipe processes are standardized per linear foot of pipe produced.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Pipe processes are standardized per linear foot of pipe produced.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Scope: material inputs, input transport and energy use required for pipe production. Data was adapted from literature. Some relevant flows not captured. Uncertainty ranges are not available for this data.
processDocumentation.useAdvice: Pipe processes will need to be standardized to the functional unit based on assumed lifespan and the quantity of material transported. The utilized pipe lifespan in the work that provided this data was 100 years.

reviews.details:
Proof reading details: Passed
Other details: none

processDocumentation.intendedApplication:
This process is intended to be used as a background process by LCA practitioners, industry and the general public. And is used in development of drinking water LCI data.

Situation C2 - Accounting, without system-external interatctions. The intended application is a purely descriptive accounting / documentation of the analysed system excluding existing interactions with other systems in the LCI model.
processDocumentation.projectDescription: Data were prepared by Eastern Research Group (ERG) on behalf of the U.S. EPA under Contract No. EP-C-12-021, "Environmental and Cost Life Cycle Assessment of Disinfection Options for Municipal Drinking Water Treatment"
